svg.title: Five-part loop contract for reliable agentic loops
svg.desc: Five rows: definition of done, independent verifier, layered termination, persistent state, and a human checkpoint.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Noto Sans', 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fill in all five before an agent runs unattended.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Noto Sans', 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Noto Sans', 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A machine-checkable pass or fail. Never make it good.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Noto Sans', 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Noto Sans', 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tests, linters, or a grader in a fresh context. Not self-grade.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Noto Sans', 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Noto Sans', 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Done-check, step cap, budget, and a no-progress detector.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Noto Sans', 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Noto Sans', 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A log or git history so a crash resumes instead of restarting.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Noto Sans', 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Noto Sans', 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Review before merge, deploy, or any irreversible action.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Noto Sans', 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Skip any one of these and the loop becomes an expensive random walk.
